methodologyNotes: The roster covers gas, battery, and corded chainsaws spanning entry-level homeowner saws through prosumer models. All 13 candidates were independently re-verified in June 2026 against manufacturer product pages (stihlusa.com, husqvarna.com, egopowerplus.com, makitatools.com, dewalt.com, echo-usa.com, ryobitools.com, greenworkstools.com, oregonproducts.com, milwaukeetool.com) and major retail/spec listings (Lowes, Home Depot, Tractor Supply, Acme Tools, Ace Hardware, Amazon) plus specialist reviews (opereviews.com, protoolreviews.com, chainsawjournal.com, consumerreports.org). The Echo CS-400 is retained as a recently discontinued model still widely circulating; its current replacement is the CS-4010 (41.6 cc, $319.99 MSRP). Weight values reflect powerhead-only or tool-only figures unless noted in priceNote. Boolean specs are true only when confirmed in official documentation or a named review; null when unconfirmable. priceUsd is US MSRP or widely listed retail in USD as of the access date; null when no published USD price could be confirmed. Corrections applied: EGO CS1804 price 349.99->399.99 and anti_vibration true->null; Greenworks 80V price 299.99->379.99; Oregon CS1500 weight 13.2->12.6; Husqvarna 120 Mark II releaseDate 2019->null; Echo CS-400 and DeWalt source URLs repaired. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Stihl MS 271 Farm Boss
products.priceNote: MSRP per stihlusa.com e-commerce page; dealer prices vary (often $479-$529)
products.provenance: Engine displacement 50.2 cc and powerhead weight 12.3-12.4 lbs confirmed on STIHL USA product page; MSRP $539.99 confirmed on the same e-commerce page (verified 2026-06-19). Anti-vibration and side-access tool-less chain tensioner standard; automatic oiler standard on all MS 271 configurations.

products.name: Stihl MSA 220 C-B
products.priceNote: Bare-tool MSRP (16in bar and chain included, no battery/charger) per stihlusa.com
products.provenance: Bare-tool price $449.99 (16in bar w/o battery and charger) confirmed on stihlusa.com product page 2026-06-19. Powerhead-only weight 6.4 lbs (10.4 lbs with AP 300 S battery) per OPE Reviews. Quick Chain Adjuster provides tool-less tensioning; Ematic system provides automatic oiling. 36 V rated (40 V max). Brushless design with minimal vibration; release circa 2020.

products.name: Husqvarna 455 Rancher
products.priceNote: Common US dealer retail; Husqvarna US site does not publish a fixed MSRP (street $517-$589)
products.provenance: Engine 55.5 cc, standard 20in bar, and powerhead weight 13.2 lbs confirmed on husqvarna.com/us product page 2026-06-19. LowVib anti-vibration and adjustable automatic oil pump confirmed on the same page; side-mounted tool-less tensioner per multiple reviews. Price $549.99 reflects common US dealer listing (street range $517-$589); Husqvarna US does not publish a fixed MSRP.

products.name: Husqvarna 120 Mark II
products.priceNote: Typical US retail (Amazon/dealer); Husqvarna does not publish a fixed US MSRP. Note: superseded by 120 Mark III but Mark II still sold
products.provenance: Engine 38 cc (38.2 cc) and powerhead weight 10.7 lbs confirmed on husqvarna.com/us page (the /120/ page resolves to the 120 Mark II / base 120). LowVib anti-vibration and automatic oiler confirmed. Standard bar 14in (range 14-18). Tool-less tensioning could not be definitively confirmed (sources conflict on whether a combi tool is required) so set null. releaseDate downgraded from 2019 to null: parts catalog dates the model 2018-05 while reviews cite 2018-2019, so exact year is unverifiable.

products.name: EGO Power+ CS1804
products.priceNote: MSRP for kit with 5.0 Ah battery and charger per EGO dealers; frequently discounted to ~$299.99
products.provenance: 56 V platform, 18in bar, tool-free dial tensioning, and automatic oiler confirmed on EGO official page. Tool-only weight 12.25 lbs (operating ~14.5 lbs with battery) per TechReviewer. Kit MSRP corrected from $349.99 to $399.99 (confirmed at multiple EGO dealers and official listing; sale-priced near $299.99). anti_vibration corrected from true to null: Consumer Reports lists no dedicated anti-vibration feature (only a wrap-around handle), so the claim is not corroborated by primary documentation.

products.name: Makita XCU04 (18V X2 LXT)
products.priceNote: Tool-only (XCU04Z) widely listed price; kit (XCU04PT/CM) priced higher (~$389-$659)
products.provenance: 36 V (2x18 V), 16in bar, tool-less chain adjustment, and adjustable automatic chain lubrication confirmed on makitatools.com XCU04Z page 2026-06-19. Tool-only weight 8.3 lbs (11.1 lbs with battery) confirmed on the same page. Anti-vibration handle per Pro Tool Reviews. Tool-only price ~$379.99 widely listed.

products.name: DeWalt FLEXVOLT DCCS670
products.priceNote: Kit (DCCS670X1) with 3.0 Ah battery per Acme Tools/Home Depot; tool-only (DCCS670B) less
products.provenance: 60 V MAX (54 V nominal), 16in bar, tool-free chain tensioning, and auto-oiling confirmed on dewalt.com product page (source URL corrected to /en-us/ path; old /product/ path was wrong). System weight 12.24 lbs. Kit price $389 confirmed at Acme Tools (was $399). Anti-vibration not called out in official documentation, kept null.

products.name: Echo CS-400
products.priceNote: Discontinued circa 2023; replaced by CS-4010 (MSRP $319.99). Last retail ~$279-$299. No current USD MSRP available.
products.provenance: Engine 40.2 cc, dry weight 10.1 lbs, anti-vibration (rubber-molded handle + AV system), adjustable automatic oiler, and side-access/easy-adjust tensioner all confirmed in Echo's CS-400 spec sheet and multi-source reviews. Source URL repaired: the prior echo-usa.com/Products/Chainsaws/CS-400 page no longer shows the model (now a generic category landing page) since the CS-400 was discontinued; replaced with the manufacturer CS-400 spec PDF. Replaced by CS-4010 (41.6 cc, $319.99 MSRP); priceUsd null as no current US MSRP exists. 18in bar is the cited config (also offered in 16in).

products.name: Greenworks Pro 80V 18" Chainsaw
products.priceNote: Current price for 2.0 Ah kit (model GCS80420 / SKU 2000002) per greenworkstools.com
products.provenance: 80 V platform, 18in bar, automatic oiler, and weight 10.8 lbs confirmed on greenworkstools.com and retailer listings. Price corrected from $299.99 to $379.99 (current price listed on the official Greenworks product page for the 2.0 Ah GCS80420/2000002 kit, verified 2026-06-19). Tensioning is side-adjust (not fully tool-less), so tool_less_chain_tensioning stays false. Anti-vibration (5x less vibration vs gas per Greenworks) confirmed.

products.name: Ryobi 40V HP Brushless 14" Chainsaw
products.priceNote: Kit with single 4.0 Ah battery (RY405100) per ryobitools.com
products.provenance: 40 V, 14in bar, and adjustable automatic oiler confirmed on ryobitools.com (RY405100). Kit price $259.00 confirmed on the official product page 2026-06-19. Tool-body weight ~11.38 lbs (assembled ~13.6 lbs) per manual/retailer data. Chain tensioning uses a stored on-board tool (not fully tool-less), kept false. Anti-vibration not confirmed in official documentation, kept null.

products.name: Oregon CS1500
products.priceNote: Street price ~$109-$130 at major retailers; Oregon does not publish a fixed US MSRP
products.provenance: 15 A / 2400 W, 18in bar, tool-less ring tensioning, and built-in Lubri-Tec automatic oiler confirmed on oregonproducts.com (2026-06-19) and TechReviewer. Weight corrected from 13.2 lbs to 12.6 lbs: the official page lists 17.02 lbs but that is the packaged/shipping weight; major retailers (Amazon/Lowes) and reviews consistently cite ~12-12.6 lbs as the tool weight. Anti-vibration not mentioned in official documentation, kept null. No fixed US MSRP; street price ~$109-$130.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 16" Chainsaw
products.priceNote: Tool-only (2727-20) regular price per Ace Hardware; kits priced higher
products.provenance: M18 platform, 16in Oregon bar, and automatic oiler confirmed on milwaukeetool.com. Tool-only weight 10.7 lbs per multiple retailer listings. Tensioning uses a traditional dual-stud system requiring a scrench (the tool ships with one), so tool_less stays false. Anti-vibration not specified in official Milwaukee documentation, kept null. Tool-only price $329.00 confirmed as regular price at Ace Hardware 2026-06-19.

products.name: Echo CS-4010
products.priceNote: Official ECHO product page (echo-usa.com) lists "MSRP | $339.99 - $399.99" across configurations; $339.99 is the base 18 in. config (low end of the published range) and appears verbatim on that page. Retailer Eastern Outdoor Power lists the same CS-4010 (41.6 cc) "Starting at $366.99".
products.provenance: Model identity confirmed on the official ECHO product page (echo-usa.com/chainsaws/cs-4010) and its support spec sheet: CS-4010 is a 41.6 cc, 2-stroke gas rear-handle saw with an 18 in. bar, automatic oiler, spring "Anti-vibration device" (listed as a standard feature), and a side-access chain tensioner; the product-page Specs table lists engine displacement 41.6 cc and dry weight 9.4 lb. Price: the official page lists an MSRP range of $339.99–$399.99 across configurations, of which $339.99 is the base 18 in. config; retailer Eastern Outdoor Power corroborates the same CS-4010 (41.6 cc) "Starting at $366.99". tool_less_chain_tensioning left null because the pages describe a "side-access" tensioner but never explicitly confirm tool-free operation, and the support sheet lists a slightly different dry weight of 9.3 lb (4.2 kg) than the product page's 9.4 lb.

products.name: Stihl MS 170
products.priceNote: STIHL authorized-dealer price $199.99 (Howard Brothers, howardbrothers.com, an authorized STIHL dealer reproducing STIHL's spec sheet). Southern States independently lists $239.99. STIHL USA does not publish a fixed online MSRP (final price is dealer-set).
products.provenance: Model identity confirmed as the exact STIHL MS 170 (30.1 cc gas, 16 in recommended bar) on the authorized STIHL dealer page (Howard Brothers), which reproduces STIHL's official specification sheet verbatim: "Power Source: Gas", "Displacement: 30.1 cc.", "Powerhead Weight: 8.6 lbs.", "Guide Bar Length (Recommended): 16 in.", plus the STIHL Anti-Vibration System and Ematic automatic chain lubrication. Price $199.99 is stated on that same STIHL-dealer page (Southern States independently lists $239.99; Amazon confirms the Stihl MS 170 as a 30 cc gas saw with an anti-vibration system). The stihlusa.com URL is the manufacturer's official MS 170 product page, but its e-commerce content is dealer-gated/JS-rendered, so all spec values were extracted verbatim from the authorized-dealer reproduction of STIHL's spec sheet and cross-checked against Amazon. Tool-less chain tensioning is left null: the base MS 170 spec sheet does not list a Quick Chain Adjuster, so it could not be confirmed for this configuration; releaseDate null as no year is stated on any fetched page.

products.name: Husqvarna 440
products.priceNote: Widely-listed US dealer retail $399.99 (unit with 18in bar and chain) for SKU 970612338 / 970 61 23-38 per daveslawnmower.com ("Regular price $399.99 USD") and thepowertoolstore.com ($399.99); Husqvarna US does not publish a fixed MSRP on its product page.
products.provenance: The Husqvarna US product page for the 440 (model 970 61 23-38, SKU 970612338) confirms the exact model: an X-TORQ 40.9 cm3 gas engine, standard 18 in bar ("Bar length (inch) 18 in"), powerhead weight 9.78 lbs ("Weight (excl. cutting equipment) 9.78 lbs"), LowVib anti-vibration dampeners, and a fixed-flow automatic chain oiler ("Oil pump type: Fixed flow", "No Oil at Idle"). That page's FAQ explicitly states the standard 440 uses a scrench while only the 440e adds tool-less chain tensioning, so tool_less_chain_tensioning is set false (not null). The $399.99 US price and the 40.9 cm3 / 18 in / 9.78 lbs figures are independently corroborated on the Dave's Lawnmower Repair dealer listing for the identical SKU (970612338 / 970 61 23-38); Husqvarna US publishes no fixed MSRP, so priceUsd reflects widely-listed US dealer retail. releaseDate is null as no year is stated on any fetched page.

products.name: DeWalt FLEXVOLT DCCS677
products.priceNote: No fixed US MSRP is published on DeWalt's tool-only DCCS677B product page, and the cited retailer lists the saw as "Add to Cart for Price" with no figure shown, so no USD price could be sourced verbatim from a fetched page; priceUsd left null.
products.provenance: DeWalt's official DCCS677B product page confirms the exact model — it lists "Includes (1) DCCS677 Chainsaw", 60V MAX (60V max / 54V nominal) battery power, a 20-in. bar, brushless motor, continuous auto-oiling, and "Quick chain adjustment with onboard wrench" plus a bundled Tensioning Tool (i.e., tooled, not tool-free tensioning), verified 2026-07-10. Coastal Tool's DCCS677Y1 listing — which also packs "(1) DCCS677 Chainsaw" — independently confirms the 20-in. bar, the auto-oiling feature, "tooled chain tensioning", and states a Tool Weight of 12.6 lbs (TechReviewer's DCCS677B spec sheet likewise lists Tool-Free Chain Tensioning: NO). No fixed USD MSRP was shown on the DeWalt product page or the cited retailer ("Add to Cart for Price"), so priceUsd is left null, and anti-vibration is not stated on any fetched page so it is left null.

products.name: Makita UC4051A
products.priceNote: Retailer price $339.00 at Tool Nut (schema.org "price": 339.0 USD, sku UC4051A; compare_at_price equal, not discounted). Makita's product page publishes no MSRP; no fixed US MSRP available.
products.provenance: The makitatools.com product page confirms this is the exact model UC4051A, a 16-inch corded electric chainsaw, listing Power Type: Corded, Guide Bar Length 16", Net Weight 12.3 lbs., Chain Speed 2,900 FPM, an automatic chain oiler, and "Tool-less" blade/chain adjustment by simply turning a lever; it publishes no amperage, voltage, price, or release date. The Tool Nut retailer listing (sku UC4051A, "Makita UC4051A Corded 16\" Electric Chain Saw") corroborates the identity and adds the "Powerful 14.5 Amp motor" rating and the price of $339.00 (schema.org price 339.0 USD, compare_at equal so not on sale). No anti-vibration/AVT feature is claimed on either page (only rubberized grip handles), so anti_vibration is left null; 120 V is not stated verbatim on either page, so the electrical rating is limited to the sourced 14.5 A.

products.name: Craftsman V60 16" Chainsaw (CMCCS660)
products.priceNote: No verbatim USD price could be sourced from a fetched page. The Amazon listing for kit CMCCS660E1 shows "Currently unavailable" with no price, and other retailer/spec pages (Lowe's, Ace Hardware, CPO Outlets) returned HTTP 403 or exposed price only via JavaScript. priceUsd left null rather than guessed.
products.provenance: Craftsman's official CMCCS660 instruction manual (hosted on ManualsLib) confirms the exact model as the "60V max* 16" (40 cm) chain saw," verifying the 60 V platform and 16-inch bar; the manufacturer's own craftsman.com product page now redirects to the homepage (model discontinued/unavailable), so the official manual serves as the manufacturer source. The Amazon listing for kit CMCCS660E1 confirms model identity (included component "(1) CMCCS660 16" Chainsaw" plus the CMCB6025 V60 2.5AH battery and charger), Battery power source, the 16-inch low-kickback bar and chain, brushless motor, and "Auto Oiling - With tool free tensioning" (automatic oiler plus tool-less tensioning). No verbatim USD price was available (Amazon lists it "Currently unavailable" and other retailer pages were blocked or JS-only), so priceUsd is null; weight_lb is null because only a kit/package weight (8.5 kg) was published, not a tool-only figure.
